title: Zindaa se Chuti Karbobala Jati Hai Zainab
body:
Zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab, shabbir ke chehlum ke liye aati hai Zainab
Har gaam pa ek zulm naya paati hain Zainab, hamrah lute qafile ko laati hai Zainab, peene ke liye ashk hain gham khati hai Zainab, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab
Juz bekasi-o-yaas koi paas nahin hai, Akbar nahin Qasim nahi Abbas nahin hai, bin bhayi ke jeene ki koi aas nahin hai, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab
Shabbir ki turbat pa barasti hai udasi, rone ki kisi maa ke ek aati hai sada si, chod aayi Sakina ko bhi zindaan mein pyasi, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaidi hui zindaan mein gayi zulm uthaya, afsana-e-shabbir zamaane ko sunaya, mazloom ka gham khana-e-zalim mein sunaya, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab
Bin bhai ke ab zeest se bezaar hain Zainab, mohtaaje rida bekas-o-nachaar hain Zainab, saidaniyoun ki qhafela salaar hain Zainab, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab
Haq apna zamaane pe jatate hue guzri, soi hui millat ko jagate hue guzri, matam mein hasan shah ke rulate hue guzri, zindaan se chuti karbo bala jaati hai Zainab..
